description.value: Kelly's Pub has been a neighbourhood fixture in Surrey since opening on April 2, 2001, offering draft beer, pub grub (chicken wings, nachos, burgers, steaks, and dishes like Pad Thai), and an on-site liquor store. Entertainment runs throughout the week with pool tables, darts, karaoke nights, and a Sunday meat draw, giving it a lively community-hub feel. The pub pitches itself as a full evening-out destination with a strong AV setup and relaxed, irreverent atmosphere.
